create_trainer_for_isdf: create a Trainer instance with a config file to initialize an implicit SDF mapping pipeline for 3D scene reconstruction
run_training_step: run a single training step on the SDF network by sampling rays, computing loss, and backpropagating gradients
reconstruct_mesh_from_sdf: reconstruct a 3D mesh from the trained SDF grid using marching cubes and optionally crop with point cloud proximity
evaluate_sdf_against_ground_truth: evaluate the predicted SDF values against ground truth SDF using L1 loss, binned losses, and CHOMP cost metrics
visualize_sdf_slices: compute and visualize 2D slices through the 3D SDF grid with optional ground truth comparison and camera pose markers
